feedback: The minimization SPARQL checks the wrong comparison dimension: it compares capacities of different structural members at the same location, rather than verifying that each member's selected ice-load application location is where that member's capacity under the combined bending-and-shear effects is minimal across applicable locations. Rework the bounded comparison to pair the member's selected load case with alternative load cases/locations for that same member, and ensure the compared capacity is explicitly associated with the corresponding load case and combined effect; do not leave combinedShearBendingEffect as an unused presence-only operand. Also explicitly bind the design case and selected load-case location to the supplied hasIceLoadPatch relationship so the comparison proves application of the identified ice load patch, not merely independent ship-level presence.
